tweets.text:
ICE @HSISaintPaul arrested U.S. citizens Shamso Ahmed Hassan and Hanaan Mursal Yusuf for their alleged roles in a scheme to defraud Medicaid of $21.1M by exploiting a Minnesota program.

Hassan allegedly enrolled the following two companies as service providers for the Minnesota Early Intensive Development and Behavioral Intervention Program:
• Smart Therapy Center LLC 
• Star Autism Center LLC

➡️Both subjects allegedly submitted false and fraudulent claims to Medicaid from May 2020 to December 2024 using both companies.

➡️Both subjects were taken into custody at their shared home and remain in federal custody pending judicial proceedings. 

🔎This is an @FBI-led investigation. ICE @HSI_HQ is proud to be a part of the investigative team enforcing @POTUS Trump’s mandate to end benefits fraud.
